# doc-lag

> Detect documentation made stale by a code change. Local-first CLI, GitHub Action, and read-only MCP server. Evidence-backed findings for developers, CI, and coding agents.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/doc-lag
GitHub: https://github.com/TarcisioPhilips/doc-lag
License: MIT

## Quick commands

```bash
npx doc-lag scan --base main
npx -y doc-lag mcp
npx -y -p doc-lag doc-lag-mcp
```

## Agent setup (copy-paste for coding agents)

Set up doc-lag in this repo following https://github.com/TarcisioPhilips/doc-lag/blob/main/docs/AGENT_SETUP.md

## Versions

- Published npm: 0.2.1 (CLI `scan` / `mcp`, Action `@v0`, no `--rank`)
- Optional Jev ranking (`--rank jev`): on `main`, ships as 0.3.0 — enable only when the user asks; requires TYPESAFE_API_KEY
